title: JetBrains WSL agent mode starts the daemon with --host wsl
description:
Objective: JetBrains' 'Run Agents in WSL' toggle starts the daemon with the WSL-scoped bind from task-2f2484b4 (`--host wsl`) instead of --host 0.0.0.0. This task was split out of task-724e31fa, the HIGH security row, which stays the final verification row.

Deliverable:
- In moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt, add a companion constant WSL_BIND_HOST = "wsl". Use it at all three sites that add --host for WSL agents today:
  - protectedDaemonCommand;
  - buildDaemonCommand's hostSuffix;
  - buildDirectDaemonCommand.
- Update the comment in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/TerminalAgentLauncher.kt that says the spawner passes --host 0.0.0.0.
- In RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest, update the pin on the protected argv, which says `--host 0.0.0.0` today.
- Add new MoeDaemonSupervisorTest rows that pin both legacy start commands with wslAgentsEnabled on and off.

Ordering: this edits files the CQ-RF tasks also edit (MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt, MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt, RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest.kt).
- It dependsOn RF01 (task-fd653cfb) and RF02 (task-f3485ac9).
- RF03 (task-ec64165c) waits for this task.
- Read the landed bytes.

Not in scope:
- daemon code (task-2f2484b4);
- moe-agent.sh and docs (task-724e31fa);
- VS Code, which has no WSL agent mode;
- RF behavior.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required), under the jetbrains-gradle lease:
cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"
This is the same as `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test`; this WSL host has no JDK.
definitionOfDone: With wslAgentsEnabled, every daemon start command the supervisor builds (protected direct, legacy direct and legacy shell) carries `--host wsl` and never 0.0.0.0. Without it, none carries --host. Proven by MoeDaemonSupervisorTest rows and the updated RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest pin.
No `0.0.0.0` remains under moe-jetbrains/src/main, shown by a grep quoted in complete_task's summary.
The verification command exits 0, with its output supplied to complete_task.

1. moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest.kt, test `S1 protected selection runs only the installed node and daemon`. Change only the pin `true to listOf("--host", "0.0.0.0")` to `true to listOf("--host", "wsl")`. The false row stays emptyList().

2. moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt: add two tests beside the legacy-spawn test. Every expectation uses the literal "wsl", never the production constant: a pin that reads the constant follows a mutated constant.

- `W1 legacy direct start passes --host wsl only in WSL agent mode`. For wsl in listOf(false, true):
  - Set up root = initializedRoot("w1-$wsl") and write packages/moe-daemon/dist/index.js under it. findInParents finds it before any bundled or global-config copy.
  - Build the supervisor with named arguments: MoeDaemonSupervisor(root.absolutePath, "Test Project", processStarter = { started += it.command().toList(); FakeProcess() }, wslAgentsEnabled = { wsl }, profile = { RuntimeProfile.LEGACY }).
  - assertTrue(ensureDaemonRunning()).
  - With cmd = started.single(), assert exact equality of cmd.drop(2) with listOf("start", "--project", root.absolutePath) + (if (wsl) listOf("--host", "wsl") else emptyList()).
  - Assert File(cmd[1]).canonicalFile equals the written script's canonicalFile.
  - Assert "0.0.0.0" !in cmd.
  - cmd[0], the node, depends on the environment and stays unasserted.

- `W2 legacy shell start command appends --host wsl only in WSL agent mode`. It calls supervisor.buildDaemonCommand(root.absolutePath) directly. ensureDaemonRunning reaches that branch only when no repo, bundled or global-config script exists, which depends on the machine.
  - Guard with Assume.assumeTrue(System.getenv("MOE_DAEMON_COMMAND").isNullOrBlank()), because that override is the operator's verbatim command.
  - wsl=true: the command ends with " --host wsl", has exactly one "--host", and contains `--project "<root>"`.
  - wsl=false: the command contains no "--host".
  - Neither contains "0.0.0.0".
  - Both the Windows Program Files start-daemon.cmd branch and the `moe-daemon start` fallback end with the suffix, so the assertions hold on any machine. Say so in a one-line comment.

3. So W2 compiles, change only `private fun buildDaemonCommand` to `internal fun buildDaemonCommand` in MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt. It is a test seam, as protectedDaemonCommand and findInParents already are (mem:gotcha-kotlin-internal-visible-from-test-sourceset).

The verify step's mutants prove these rows fail on the old 0.0.0.0 behavior, so no separate red run is needed here.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- A wslHostArgs() helper shared by the three sites: rejected. Three one-line uses of the constant are smaller, and each site has its own test row.
- Testing the shell command through ensureDaemonRunning: rejected. That branch runs only when no repo, bundled or global-config daemon script exists, which depends on the developer machine (PluginManagerCore, the global install path). Instead, buildDaemonCommand becomes internal and is called directly, as protectedDaemonCommand already is.
- Adding --host to the MOE_DAEMON_COMMAND override: rejected. It is the operator's verbatim command and never carried --host, so changing it would be a behavior change outside this row.
- Retrying with 0.0.0.0 when a daemon refuses 'wsl': rejected, because WSL mode must fail closed.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- ensureDaemonRunning picks the start command in this order:
  - PROTECTED uses protectedDaemonCommand.
  - Otherwise buildDirectDaemonCommand, which tries the repo dist (via findInParents), then the bundled daemon, then the global-config install.
  - If none exists, it runs the shell string from buildDaemonCommand under cmd /c or bash -lc. That string is MOE_DAEMON_COMMAND, else the Windows Program Files start-daemon.cmd, else `moe-daemon start`.
- DaemonInfo has no bindHost field. The plugin never reads the bind back, so only the argv changes.
- RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest.supervisorFor already takes wsl, and S1 iterates over wsl false and true.
- Kotlin internal is visible from the test source set.

- The mutants edit this task's own dirty file. Restore from a saved copy and cmp; never git checkout.
- MoeBundle.properties is UTF-8 and already contains an em dash. Keep it; the new words are ASCII.
- If MOE_DAEMON_COMMAND is set on the gate machine, W2 is skipped. Confirm from the XML that it ran.
